Read the diagram step by step

DOCTYPE selects standards mode. The html element contains head (metadata) and body
(content). Head and body are siblings, not successive page regions.
DOCTYPE එJකෙන් standards mode J+තෝරනවා. html root එකෙ ඇතුJළේ head සහ body Jදෙකෙම තිJයෙනවා. head එJකේ metadata, body එJකේ Jපෙන්වන content තිJයෙනවා.
